content.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Plan
content.body:
## Garden Layout
Plan for a small beginner garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, located in a spot receiving approximately 6 hours of sunlight daily. Need to confirm if this sunlight duration is sufficient for most vegetables.

## Supplies Needed
- [ ] Soil
- [ ] Containers or raised bed materials
- [ ] Seeds (tomatoes, lettuce, others TBD)
- [ ] Basic gardening tools
- [ ] Watering system (consider simple drip irrigation)

## Planting Schedule Overview
Target to have everything planted by early May. Detailed planting calendar to be referenced below for specific timing of each vegetable.

### Vegetable Planting Calendar
Specific planting dates for vegetables such as tomatoes and lettuce to be researched and added based on zone 7b climate recommendations.

## Additional Considerations
- Research companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes for better growth).
- Address pest control, especially for rabbits observed in the neighborhood; explore natural pest deterrents and fencing options.
